  - core (`crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib, bin]`): **12.0** (issue #1234:
    the named census offenders moved — CC-12 trio + readPasteboardImage
    16.32 split, the 0%-cov CC-3 quartet and the named CC-9 tier covered
    or split, `_listModels` covered — but the first whole-tree
    measurement showed the 8.0 repin unearned: 54 methods at 12.00
    (CC-3@0% tier + covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00. Threshold
    stays at the measured max; the tier is the next ladder card).
  - flutter_app (`flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib]`,

    `app-crap-gate` job merges the lcovs and runs the pinned analyzer —
    widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, E2).
  - The app ladder (follow-up cards, NOT this one): 2450 → 870 → 702 → 650

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_test_core() {
  echo "🧪 Running dart test --coverage (excluding integration tests)..."
  rm -rf coverage

  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"

  # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites are
  # integration-tagged — the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
  # lib/src/cli hits from them — so the unit run above skips them. Their
  # hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers (>= 80% ratchet, PR
  # diff-coverage, CRAP: jsr_cli.dart at 0% line coverage reads CRAP 156
  # against the 12.0 ceiling), so the trio runs into the SAME coverage/

  # sync with ci.yml (test-core shard 0); gh-1538 retired the nightly.yml
  # full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the single unit-lcov producer.
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --tags integration \
    test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart \
    test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart \
    test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart \
    --coverage=coverage
}

stage_integration_mock() {
  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs run on EVERY PR that touches
  # them — MockLlmServer scenarios, no secrets, no network, so they cannot
  # rot silently between releases (#538 class). Real-provider files carry
  # the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only smoke job; browser-ext owns its
  # own workflow; perf has the #303 per-PR trajectory gate; `pty` marks
  # child-agent-spawn tests (issue #553) — nightly-only, unbounded boot time.
  #
  # TMPDIR normalization (macOS hook parity): several PTY legs assert the
  # status row still shows `· ctx ` — with macOS's per-user temp root
  # (/var/folders/<30 chars>/T/...) the temp cwd eats the whole row width
  # and the assertion fails locally while ubuntu CI (/tmp) is green. Pin
  # the stage to the same short temp root CI has so hook/CI agree.
  echo "🧪 Running no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer)..."
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  #
  # Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N reruns ONLY the failed
  # files, up to N times, before the stage fails. The PTY/grid timing legs
  # are load-sensitive (the gh-1026 class: 3 red 2.5 h gate runs on an
  # unchanged head, a different ambient test red each time, every file
  # green in isolation) — the budget turns one flaky PTY case from a full
  # leg rerun into a minutes-scoped file rerun, mirroring CI's
  # retrigger-recovery behaviour (ci.yml watchdog: ONE retrigger, never a
  # blind rerun). 0 (the default) keeps the single-shot leg below
  # byte-identical. Files come from scripts/gate_failed_targets.py over
  # the dart json file-reporter log; when the log yields no targets
  # (crash before the reporter flushed) the stage fails WITHOUT a rerun —
  # never rerun blind.
  local retries="${FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES:-0}"
  if [ "$retries" -le 0 ]; then
    TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
      dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} test/integration \
      --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty
    return
  fi
  local log="test-results/gate-integration-mock.json"
  mkdir -p test-results
  local targets="test/integration"
  local attempt=0
  while true; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    if TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
        dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} $targets \
        --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty \
        --file-reporter="json:$log"; then
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -gt "$retries" ]; then
      echo "❌ flake budget exhausted ($retries rerun(s)) — integration leg stays red" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    local failed
    failed=$(python3 scripts/gate_failed_targets.py "$log")
    if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
      echo "   no failed-file targets in $log — not rerunning blind" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "🔁 flake budget: rerun $attempt/$retries — failed files only:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$failed" | sed 's/^/   /' >&2
    targets="$failed"
  done
}

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. ## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto

tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —

(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script

size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`

and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.

  live models never.** Real-provider files carry

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

The CRAP gate: threshold 12.0, requires lcov coverage (`coverage/lcov.info`), `run_tests: false` — the CI regenerates coverage before CRAP runs.

The "CRAP + duplication" CI job failed. The most likely cause: `readPasteboardText` or one of the new methods has CRAP score > 12 given its coverage, OR the duplication gate found clones (e.g. `_readLinuxText` vs `_readLinux`, `_readWindowsText` vs ... ).

Interesting: `_readLinuxText` and `_readLinux` are quite similar structures (loop over (executable, args) list), and `_readWindowsText` vs `_readWindows`... but jscpd duplication is usually token-based; the clone between `_readLinux` and `_readLinuxText` might be caught. Also `_osascriptClipboardClassToFile` vs original code.

stage_test_core() {
  echo "🧪 Running dart test --coverage (excluding integration tests)..."
  rm -rf coverage
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration
  # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites are
  # integration-tagged — the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
  # lib/src/cli hits from them — so the unit run above skips them. Their
  # hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers (>= 80% ratchet, PR
  # diff-coverage, CRAP: jsr_cli.dart at 0% line coverage reads CRAP 156
  # against the 12.0 ceiling), so the trio runs into the SAME coverage/
  # dir; format_coverage merges the per-isolate files. Keep this list in
  # sync with ci.yml (test-core shard 0); gh-1538 retired the nightly.yml
  # full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the single unit-lcov producer.
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --tags integration \
    test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart \
    test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart \
    test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart \
    --coverage=coverage
}

stage_integration_mock() {
  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs run on EVERY PR that touches
  # them — MockLlmServer scenarios, no secrets, no network, so they cannot
  # rot silently between releases (#538 class). Real-provider files carry
  # the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only smoke job; browser-ext owns its
  # own workflow; perf has the #303 per-PR trajectory gate; `pty` marks
  # child-agent-spawn tests (issue #553) — nightly-only, unbounded boot time.
  #
  # TMPDIR normalization (macOS hook parity): several PTY legs assert the
  # status row still shows `· ctx ` — with macOS's per-user temp root
  # (/var/folders/<30 chars>/T/...) the temp cwd eats the whole row width
  # and the assertion fails locally while ubuntu CI (/tmp) is green. Pin
  # the stage to the same short temp root CI has so hook/CI agree.
  echo "🧪 Running no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer)..."
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  #
  # Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N reruns ONLY the failed
  # files, up to N times, before the stage fails. The PTY/grid timing legs
  # are load-sensitive (the gh-1026 class: 3 red 2.5 h gate runs on an
  # unchanged head, a different ambient test red each time, every file
  # green in isolation) — the budget turns one flaky PTY case from a full
  # leg rerun into a minutes-scoped file rerun, mirroring CI's
  # retrigger-recovery behaviour (ci.yml watchdog: ONE retrigger, never a
  # blind rerun). 0 (the default) keeps the single-shot leg below
  # byte-identical. Files come from scripts/gate_failed_targets.py over
  # the dart json file-reporter log; when the log yields no targets
  # (crash before the reporter flushed) the stage fails WITHOUT a rerun —
  # never rerun blind.
  local retries="${FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES:-0}"
  if [ "$retries" -le 0 ]; then
    TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
      dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} test/integration \
      --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty
    return
  fi
  local log="test-results/gate-integration-mock.json"
  mkdir -p test-results
  local targets="test/integration"
  local attempt=0
  while true; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    if TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
        dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} $targets \
        --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty \
        --file-reporter="json:$log"; then
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -gt "$retries" ]; then
      echo "❌ flake budget exhausted ($retries rerun(s)) — integration leg stays red" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    local failed
    failed=$(python3 scripts/gate_failed_targets.py "$log")
    if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
      echo "   no failed-file targets in $log — not rerunning blind" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "🔁 flake budget: rerun $attempt/$retries — failed files only:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$failed" | sed 's/^/   /' >&2
    targets="$failed"
  done
}

stage_coverage() {

    echo "❌ coverage/ not found — run the test-core stage first" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "📊 Formatting coverage to lcov..."
  dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

    local files=""

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

blocks.text:
# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above
  cannot see across module boundaries).
- CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze`, tool pinned as
  `dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"` — gh-1106

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known

# ── Stage implementations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
stage_analyze() {
  echo "🔍 Running dart analyze..."
  dart analyze
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ensure_app_placeholders
    echo "🔍 Running flutter analyze (flutter_app)..."
    (cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings)
    FLUTTER_ANALYZED=1
  fi
}

stage_test_core() {
  echo "🧪 Running dart test --coverage (excluding integration tests)..."
  rm -rf coverage
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration
  # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites are
  # integration-tagged — the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
  # lib/src/cli hits from them — so the unit run above skips them. Their
  # hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers (>= 80% ratchet, PR
  # diff-coverage, CRAP: jsr_cli.dart at 0% line coverage reads CRAP 156
  # against the 12.0 ceiling), so the trio runs into the SAME coverage/
  # dir; format_coverage merges the per-isolate files. Keep this list in
  # sync with ci.yml (test-core shard 0); gh-1538 retired the nightly.yml
  # full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the single unit-lcov producer.
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --tags integration \
    test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart \
    test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart \
    test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart \
    --coverage=coverage
}

stage_integration_mock() {
  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs run on EVERY PR that touches
  # them — MockLlmServer scenarios, no secrets, no network, so they cannot
  # rot silently between releases (#538 class). Real-provider files carry
  # the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only smoke job; browser-ext owns its
  # own workflow; perf has the #303 per-PR trajectory gate; `pty` marks
  # child-agent-spawn tests (issue #553) — nightly-only, unbounded boot time.
  #
  # TMPDIR normalization (macOS hook parity): several PTY legs assert the
  # status row still shows `· ctx ` — with macOS's per-user temp root
  # (/var/folders/<30 chars>/T/...) the temp cwd eats the whole row width
  # and the assertion fails locally while ubuntu CI (/tmp) is green. Pin
  # the stage to the same short temp root CI has so hook/CI agree.
  echo "🧪 Running no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer)..."
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  #
  # Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N reruns ONLY the failed
  # files, up to N times, before the stage fails. The PTY/grid timing legs
  # are load-sensitive (the gh-1026 class: 3 red 2.5 h gate runs on an
  # unchanged head, a different ambient test red each time, every file
  # green in isolation) — the budget turns one flaky PTY case from a full
  # leg rerun into a minutes-scoped file rerun, mirroring CI's
  # retrigger-recovery behaviour (ci.yml watchdog: ONE retrigger, never a
  # blind rerun). 0 (the default) keeps the single-shot leg below
  # byte-identical. Files come from scripts/gate_failed_targets.py over
  # the dart json file-reporter log; when the log yields no targets
  # (crash before the reporter flushed) the stage fails WITHOUT a rerun —
  # never rerun blind.
  local retries="${FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES:-0}"
  if [ "$retries" -le 0 ]; then
    TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
      dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} test/integration \
      --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty
    return
  fi
  local log="test-results/gate-integration-mock.json"
  mkdir -p test-results
  local targets="test/integration"
  local attempt=0
  while true; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    if TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
        dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} $targets \
        --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty \
        --file-reporter="json:$log"; then
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -gt "$retries" ]; then
      echo "❌ flake budget exhausted ($retries rerun(s)) — integration leg stays red" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    local failed
    failed=$(python3 scripts/gate_failed_targets.py "$log")
    if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
      echo "   no failed-file targets in $log — not rerunning blind" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "🔁 flake budget: rerun $attempt/$retries — failed files only:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$failed" | sed 's/^/   /' >&2
    targets="$failed"
  done
}

stage_crap() {

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

stage_test_core() {
  echo "🧪 Running dart test --coverage (excluding integration tests)..."
  rm -rf coverage
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration
  # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites are
  # integration-tagged — the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
  # lib/src/cli hits from them — so the unit run above skips them. Their
  # hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers (>= 80% ratchet, PR
  # diff-coverage, CRAP: jsr_cli.dart at 0% line coverage reads CRAP 156
  # against the 12.0 ceiling), so the trio runs into the SAME coverage/
  # dir; format_coverage merges the per-isolate files. Keep this list in
  # sync with ci.yml (test-core shard 0); gh-1538 retired the nightly.yml
  # full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the single unit-lcov producer.
  dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --tags integration \
    test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart \
    test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart \
    test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart \
    --coverage=coverage
}

stage_integration_mock() {
  # Issue #551: the no-key integration legs run on EVERY PR that touches
  # them — MockLlmServer scenarios, no secrets, no network, so they cannot
  # rot silently between releases (#538 class). Real-provider files carry
  # the `llm` tag and stay in the tag-only smoke job; browser-ext owns its
  # own workflow; perf has the #303 per-PR trajectory gate; `pty` marks
  # child-agent-spawn tests (issue #553) — nightly-only, unbounded boot time.
  #
  # TMPDIR normalization (macOS hook parity): several PTY legs assert the
  # status row still shows `· ctx ` — with macOS's per-user temp root
  # (/var/folders/<30 chars>/T/...) the temp cwd eats the whole row width
  # and the assertion fails locally while ubuntu CI (/tmp) is green. Pin
  # the stage to the same short temp root CI has so hook/CI agree.
  echo "🧪 Running no-key integration legs (MockLlmServer)..."
  local conc="${FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  #
  # Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N reruns ONLY the failed
  # files, up to N times, before the stage fails. The PTY/grid timing legs
  # are load-sensitive (the gh-1026 class: 3 red 2.5 h gate runs on an
  # unchanged head, a different ambient test red each time, every file
  # green in isolation) — the budget turns one flaky PTY case from a full
  # leg rerun into a minutes-scoped file rerun, mirroring CI's
  # retrigger-recovery behaviour (ci.yml watchdog: ONE retrigger, never a
  # blind rerun). 0 (the default) keeps the single-shot leg below
  # byte-identical. Files come from scripts/gate_failed_targets.py over
  # the dart json file-reporter log; when the log yields no targets
  # (crash before the reporter flushed) the stage fails WITHOUT a rerun —
  # never rerun blind.
  local retries="${FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES:-0}"
  if [ "$retries" -le 0 ]; then
    TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
      dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} test/integration \
      --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty
    return
  fi
  local log="test-results/gate-integration-mock.json"
  mkdir -p test-results
  local targets="test/integration"
  local attempt=0
  while true; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    if TMPDIR="${FA_GATE_TMPDIR:-/tmp}" \
        dart test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} $targets \
        --exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,perf,pty \
        --file-reporter="json:$log"; then
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -gt "$retries" ]; then
      echo "❌ flake budget exhausted ($retries rerun(s)) — integration leg stays red" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    local failed
    failed=$(python3 scripts/gate_failed_targets.py "$log")
    if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
      echo "   no failed-file targets in $log — not rerunning blind" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "🔁 flake budget: rerun $attempt/$retries — failed files only:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$failed" | sed 's/^/   /' >&2
    targets="$failed"
  done
}

stage_coverage() {

    exit 1

  echo "📊 Formatting coverage to lcov..."
  dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
